# AgentPress

> AgentPress helps mid-market companies grow revenue and reduce costs with AI. We identify valuable workflows, validate the business case with the client, and build and support the automation.

This is the official AgentPress website. The Markdown pages below describe our current services and assessment. ROI estimates are planning assumptions, not guarantees; production implementation is scoped separately from the assessment.

## Services

- [Company and service overview](https://www.agent.press/index.md): Homepage content, business outcomes and common questions.
- [AI transformation assessment](https://www.agent.press/assessment.md): Three-week engagement, five deliverables, scope, price and first-build credit.
- [Implementation options](https://www.agent.press/implementation.md): Build internally using the findings or have AgentPress implement.
- [Platform and integrations](https://www.agent.press/platform.md): Deployment, security and back-office system connections.

## Company

- [Our story](https://www.agent.press/our-story): Background and approach.
- [Contact and consultation](https://www.agent.press/consultation): Book a consultation with AgentPress.
- [Support](https://www.agent.press/support): Help for existing customers.
